biotools.summary: Calculates sequence-derived molecular properties and related laboratory planning outputs from FASTA and assay setup inputs. The tool supports sequence analysis for DNA, RNA, and protein entries, plus dilution and ligation calculation modes through one API-backed workflow. Programmatic use is available through a Python library and command-line interface that submit run payloads and return structured result objects.

credit.name: Pepkio
credit.note: Pepkio develops software tools and bioinformatics solutions for life science researchers, including laboratory calculators and analysis services.

function.note: One tool endpoint supports three modes (sequence, dilution, ligation) for sequence property analysis and laboratory planning calculations.

biotools.name: Pepkio Sequence Property Calculator
